name: Netfield
description: A very fine net, at the pitch where the eye stops counting and reads a tone.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 7.7%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 7.7%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 7.7%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 7.7%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
